content: @nestjs/event-emitter wraps eventemitter2 and exposes EventEmitterModule.forRoot() + injectable EventEmitter2.emit(eventName, payload) + @OnEvent(eventName) decorator for listeners, including async listeners and wildcard patterns. This is the standard NestJS-idiomatic in-process typed event bus, appropriate for the GameStreamGapDetected seam (D-13) without adding a message broker.
